intro.text: An inkspren bonded to Jasnah Kholin, who usually appears as a tiny man in a black suit and dislikes being talked about.
An inkspren bonded to Jasnah Kholin, giving her the power to Soulcast and to travel to and from Shadesmar, and able to become her Shardblade.

items.text: Ivory and the other spren of his generation were the equivalent of children at the time of the Recreance.

On the night of Gavilar Kholin's assassination, shadowy figures formed in a palace hallway, and one, a man with a sword, approached Jasnah. She slipped into Shadesmar and rebuilt the hallway out of the sea of beads, even making a statue move its sword. The man, Ivory, saluted her with two fingers to his forehead and bowed.

Shallan glimpsed Ivory as a tiny man in Jasnah's palm aboard the Wind's Pleasure before he melted into shadow. Jasnah explained that talking about him made him anxious, and that the other inkspren saw his bond with her as a betrayal, though he would not discuss it.
When killers attacked Jasnah aboard the ship and badly wounded her, Ivory saved her by helping her pass into Shadesmar.

When Ivory and Jasnah returned from Shadesmar, Wit was waiting for them. Jasnah summoned Ivory as a Shardblade, then dismissed him when she saw Wit posed no threat, and the pair travelled with Wit at least as far as the nearest town.

In Urithiru, Ivory and Jasnah read the recorded words of the madman from Dalinar's warcamp. Ivory confirmed that the speaker was the Herald Talenel and suggested looking for him in Shadesmar. They talked over lost time, Odium's aims, spren driven mad by the Recreance, Shallan and Pattern, and what to share of Wit's knowledge.
Some days afterwards, Ivory spied for Jasnah on the stormwardens in the library beneath Urithiru when she realised they were discussing Renarin.

During the battle, Ivory rode on Jasnah's collar into the temple where they found Renarin and saw that his spren had been corrupted by Odium. Jasnah summoned Ivory as a Blade, intending to kill Renarin.

Jasnah changed her mind, dismissed Ivory and embraced Renarin. Confused, Ivory returned to his full-size form and was surprised to find that sparing Renarin felt right even though it didn't make logical sense.
Seeing Shallan Lightweaving, Ivory warned her that she was using Stormlight at a dangerous rate.

appearance.text: As a Shardblade, he is long and thin.

Ivory usually appears as a well-dressed man in a stiff, formal suit with a long coat, carrying a sword. His features are sharp and too angular to be human, with pupilless eyes, and he is inky black all over with an oily, prismatic sheen. He can change size, from a speck to a full-grown man, but not shape.

personality.text: Ivory has a noble, stiff bearing and a clipped, straightforward manner. He admires Jasnah's logic and is devoted to her, offering counsel and spying for her, but grows anxious when she speaks of him and dislikes being seen by others.
He has a rebellious streak: he bonded Jasnah against the other inkspren's wishes and took the contradictory name Ivory as an act of defiance.
